issue.body:
- Gitea version (or commit ref): 1.11.2
- Git version: 2.25.1
- Operating system: Windows 2016
- Database (use `[x]`):
  - [ ] PostgreSQL
  - [ ] MySQL
  - [ ] MSSQL
  - [x] SQLite
- Can you reproduce the bug at https://try.gitea.io:
  - [ ] Yes (provide example URL)
  - [x] No
  - [ ] Not relevant

## Description

When trying to view a Wiki page I've got this message

```
template: repo/wiki/view:48:14: executing "repo/wiki/view" at <(not $.DisableHTTP) (and (not $.DisableSSH) (or $.IsSigned $.ExposeAnonSSH))>: can't give argument to non-function not $.DisableHTTP
```

Upgraded from 1.11.1 to 1.11.2 this morning and the problem appeared.
When downgrading back to 1.11.1 the problem disapears.

I had a custom template (footer.tmpl for mermaid.js) even when removing the custom template the problem persists.

I tried on a repo without Wiki, clicked start wiki saved the default page and got the message.

issue.title: [stable/minio] Superfluous parenthesis cause templating error starting with go 1.14
issue.body:
**Describe the bug**
Running `helm template stable/minio` cause the following error : 

```Error: template: minio/templates/deployment.yaml:211:20: executing "minio/templates/deployment.yaml" at <(not .Values.gcsgateway.enabled) (not .Values.azuregateway.enabled) (not .Values.s3gateway.enabled) (not .Values.b2gateway.enabled)>: can't give argument to non-function not `.Values.gcsgateway.enabled```

**Version of Helm and Kubernetes**:
Helm : 3.1.2
Kubernetes : N/A

**Which chart**:
MinIO

**What happened**:
Helm templating fails

**What you expected to happen**:
Helm templating to work

**How to reproduce it** (as minimally and precisely as possible):
`helm template stable/minio` with up to date helm

**Anything else we need to know**:
There is a superfluous set of parenthesis line 211 of deployment.yaml 
`{{- if and ((not .Values.gcsgateway.enabled) (not .Values.azuregateway.enabled) (not .Values.s3gateway.enabled) (not .Values.b2gateway.enabled)) }}`
should be : 
`{{- if and (not .Values.gcsgateway.enabled) (not .Values.azuregateway.enabled) (not .Values.s3gateway.enabled) (not .Values.b2gateway.enabled) }}`

This seems to have been an issue here : https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/issues/10552 starting with go 1.14

I'll submit a MR ASAP, removing this set of parenthesis.

body:
# The problem persists for me
I upgraded go and giteea at the same time to:
| component | version |
| --- | --- |
| go | 1.14.2 |
| gitea | 1.11.4 |

I clicked the wiki link (after restarting) and got the same error as was described by @kode9  in this ticket
```
template: repo/wiki/view:48:14: executing "repo/wiki/view" at <(not $.DisableHTTP) (and (not $.DisableSSH) (or $.IsSigned $.ExposeAnonSSH))>: can't give argument to non-function not $.DisableHTTP
```
I had a look at the merged _fix_ from this issue:  it described removing the opening and closing parentheses on line 48 of the wiki template.  I did so on my local setup.
I re-compiled and ...

## The problem persists. 
```
template: repo/wiki/view:48:14: executing "repo/wiki/view" at <(not $.DisableHTTP) (and (not $.DisableSSH) (or $.IsSigned $.ExposeAnonSSH))>: can't give argument to non-function not $.DisableHTTP
```
Did the fix not get merged to `1.11.4`?
@dkelsey No, this was not backported to 1.11. We're building 1.11 with go 1.13. See #10584.

@guillep2k Thanks I'll rebuild with go 1.13. 

_Edit: that worked. Thanks._

Any chance of this getting backported to 1.11? Some distributions (like FreeBSD) have switched to go 1.14 as a default, exposing this bug. Or what's the timeline for a 1.12 release, which presumably would be compatible with go 1.14?

@stblassitude 1.12.0 has entered the "feature freeze" stage. A release candidate will be out within a couple of weeks, I suppose. But these are strange days and things are not as predictible as they used to be. 😓
